name: Maxwell light-wave dispersion
description: Excite a broadband electric field and recover the vacuum dispersion relation ω = ck with Struphy’s FEEC Maxwell solver.
equationsMarkdown:
**PDEs solved by model:**

Ampère's law (no current):

$$
\frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t} - \nabla \times \mathbf{B} = 0
$$

Faraday's law:

$$
\frac{\partial \mathbf{B}}{\partial t} + \nabla \times \mathbf{E} = 0
$$

figures.alt: Space-time map of the electric field of vacuum light waves
figures.caption: The electric field of the run above along z, over time. The broadband noise launches waves in both directions, which appear as criss-crossing diagonal stripes; their slope is the wave speed, c = 1 in these units, as measured in the dispersion plot.
